input.title: iOS #50 installed over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1 (progress and coins lost)
input.description:
Found on the update-path rows of the QA regression runbook during the ZOM-570 gate (Brian's update-path run for iOS #50 / Android #135).

**Device:** iPhone 13, iOS 18.6
**Source build:** N-1 store build (App Store) → **updated to:** iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50)

**What happens:** after the update the save comes back at level 1 with 500 coins. The account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins before. Relaunching doesn't bring it back.

**Repro:**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store.
2. Play past level 200.
3. Install TestFlight 50 (iOS Submission #50) over it.
4. Launch.

**Expected:** level, coins and unlocks survive the update (runbook: Save / progression, Update from N-1).

**Other update rows:** iOS N-2 → #50 pass; Android N-1 → #135 pass; Android N-2 → #135 pass.

Lost progress/coins = blocker under the ZM submission rules. Runbook: a failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release. Player-facing symptom (lost progress) should get a known-issue note in the Customer Support Playbook.

Source: "Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135" (Brian Foster, Sep 30).

---

**QA gate - Android #135 / iOS #50 (Vincent, Oct 1): NO-GO, 14 blockers**

- ZOM-581 - iOS #50 installed over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1 (progress and coins lost). Runbook update row failed; new ticket
- ZOM-449 - low-end Android: cold start into level 3 freezes, force-quit needed (#135)
- ZOM-578 - tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install (#135)
- ZOM-483 - new-install infinite lives time lost on relaunch (#135)
- ZOM-560 - abandoned pack purchase doesn't deliver the win streak freezer time (#135)
- ZOM-554 - quitting mid tornado leaves the next level unplayable until force-quit (#50)
- ZOM-546 - endless board drains, the run can't go on (#135 / #50)
- ZOM-576 - Season Pass premium tier claim drops the booster bundle (#50)
- ZOM-573 - Collect&Win 5th chest claim crashes the app (#135)
- ZOM-569 - Season Pass double-open leaves an empty screen; fix a61cb2b landed after both jobs started, so it isn't in the candidates
- ZOM-567 - Zombie Lane chest grants still don't land on prod: the #36 code is out, but the chest-row data load hasn't been run on prod
- ZOM-435 - stuck on the trophy path after a fast double claim, still happens on #135 (Leonard)
- ZOM-559 - Samsung: after homing out, the victory screen froze and needed a force-quit (latest check #133, not re-checked on the candidates yet)
- DES-313 - level 214 can't be finished, only 2 of 3 jars spawn (#135)

Full register: ZM3D Release Gate, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50".

input.message:
QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO**. There are 14 blockers, all listed by key in ZOM-570:

• **ZOM-581 (new):** updating iOS #50 over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1 / 500 coins. The account was on level 212 / 18,400 coins. This came from the runbook's update-path run. iOS N-2 and both Android update rows passed. The regression matrix only covers fresh installs, so it doesn't catch this, and a failed update row blocks on its own.
• **Crash / freeze / stuck:** ZOM-573 (Collect&Win 5th chest crash), ZOM-449 (low-end level 3 cold-start freeze), ZOM-578 (tutorial stuck at step 3), ZOM-554 (next level unplayable after quitting mid tornado), ZOM-546 (endless board drains), ZOM-435 (trophy path still sticks on #135, per Leonard), DES-313 (level 214 can't be finished), ZOM-559 (Samsung victory screen freeze; last seen on #133, not re-checked on the candidates yet)
• **Lost items / purchase not delivered:** ZOM-483 (infinite-lives time lost), ZOM-560 (abandoned pack freezer time not granted), ZOM-576 (Season Pass premium tier drops boosters)
• **ZOM-569:** the fix (a61cb2b) landed at 21:36, after both jobs started (18:43 / 18:45), so it isn't in these builds
• **ZOM-567:** backend #36 is on prod, but the chest-row data load hasn't been run on prod yet, so chests still don't land

There are 22 known issues. Fixed: ZOM-563 (live on prod), 517, 564, 429, 434, 503, 506, 557, 558, 561 and 473. The full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50".
